items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: I hear Bracay was with us, too.

ctx.x: You were saying you worked with Shilling yourself.

After I came back here, I was up north, you see. Yeah. I came back here. I stood here about two years, you see. That was Spartan with Shilling. You know? Yeah. Spartan. Spartan. Shilling had the town sold out. I'll tell you how he had the town sold out with music. See, my father had a business. I was always learning how to cut meat from a child to a child. And me being the only son, my daddy always wanted me by him. You know what I mean? I wasn't no papa's boy, but still no. He was the papa and I was the boss.…
How many cornets did you use with Shields? Two.
